hypothesis: Appliance-level maintenance references may be expressed in operating-cycle behavior rather than the first 60/120 seconds of vibration. Test duration and strictly past, label-blind ratios; preserve semantic and coverage limits.
anchor_families: duration relative to median of previous up to 10 observed cycles (minimum3)

normality_stage.scaler: RobustScaler fitted on public reference normals only
normality_stage.scope: empirical normality ranks, not physical-failure probabilities or formal coverage guarantees
normality_stage.crossfit: all Random Forest training descriptors are produced without fitting their complete reference group

smart_groups: fixed 3 outer week-block folds; remaining 2 buckets form inner cross-fitting; 293 final cycles sealed
nist_auxiliary: all previously known 14/16 SEER development references; normality held out by whole equipment stratum; aggregate descriptors by label-consistent original experiment file
tri_auxiliary: all previously known non-OC 10/12 kW references; normality held out by whole load/session collection; aggregate by test code; OC day remains sealed

classifier.class_mass: equal per source/class; source indicators never predictors

limitations: statistical analogy does not identify physical cross-source correlation
feature count and normal operating support can affect descriptor distributions
auxiliary original validation has become known development
provider model/time block does not identify a physical serial unit
closed-cycle duration supports after-cycle assessment, not time-to-failure prediction
unobserved cycles and acquisition gaps can censor history
context_policy: History stays inside the original dependency group; current/future cycles and all labels do not set its baseline. Cold starts, overlaps and gaps reset or abstain; report coverage, never fill unknown context as normal.
inference_unit: documented completed operating cycle, not an arbitrary packet/window; timestamp gaps are not assumed to mean the compressor was off
local_data_policy: no local readings; future frozen causal feature calculation is not model fitting or label calibration
